purpose: Response-blind schema qualification for a cross-scale ecological analysis separating bay-wide Zostera contraction from quantitative thinning within persistent Tier-3 transects.

relationship_to_existing_results.this_analysis_is_not: an external predictive validation of the Tampa next-year-loss endpoint

source.title: 2025 Estuarine Nutrient Enrichment Tier-2 Seagrass Monitoring Data Package

ecological_question: Do bay-wide occurrence/cover trajectories and fixed-transect quantitative trajectories reveal distinct degradation modes: landscape contraction versus within-patch thinning?

predeclared_mode_framework.landscape_axis: Tier-2 annual park-level Zostera occurrence/prevalence and, if defined in EML, quantitative cover.
predeclared_mode_framework.persistent_patch_axis: Tier-3 repeated-transect Zostera quantitative cover result already frozen in results/nps_persistent_cover_v1.json.
interpretation_classes: no directional degradation on either axis

stop_rule: If the official EML cannot support a non-arbitrary annual park-level Zostera state without inspecting CSV values, stop before response access.
